descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-25 Web & Phone Sync · S13 「手机正写着查房前记录，电脑登录」 The computer signs in while the phone is in the middle of a pre-round note

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 The same account is signed in on a phone (app) and a computer (web) at the same time. Signing in on one does not sign out the other, and both stay signed in.（UAT TC-25 step 1；UAT TC-25；TFA-94513 AC 9；TFA-94704 AC 5） — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog
  • T1 Each device goes through its own email-code sign-in (a new device always asks for a code). The two do not share a session token, and both stay valid at once.（TFA-94513 AC 6；TFA-94513 AC 10；UAT TC-25 step 1） — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress
  • U3 A pre-round note dictated and saved on the computer appears on the phone in real time, with no refresh, and can be continued on the phone without re-entering anything.（UAT TC-25 step 3；UAT TC-25；TFA-94513 AC 11；TFA-94704 AC 5） — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog
  • U6 Steps 2-5 (add, pre-round save, generate, delete) work the same in Nursing Home as in Hospital.（UAT TC-25 step 6；UAT TC-25；UAT 3.3） — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog

测试设计方法：状态迁移（state-transition） — 按先后顺序走（加 → 改 → 删、第 1 天 → 第 2 天、离线 → 在线），每一步之后看状态对不对。

Given Phone signed in, typing into {hospitalPatient}'s pre-round notes; the computer is a fresh browser context with empty storage (no session)

When The computer first opens the phone's chart by its address (/rounding/{hospitalPatient.id}); then signs in through the form with its own email code; the phone keeps typing. Run in both modes

Then The fresh computer gets the sign-in gate, not the chart: a new device is asked for a code. The phone is not signed out, its text is all still there and keeps saving, and the computer, once signed in, shows the phone's whole text

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：oracle.mjs: cp0 (computer, fresh, on the chart's address) mustContain 'Send sign-in code' and mustNotContain {hospitalPatient} and 'QA-SYNC-PR-4'; cp1 (computer) shows the list (mustContain {hospitalPatient}, mustNotContain 'Sign-in code'); cp2 (phone, no reload) mustContain 'QA-SYNC-PR-4' and mustNotContain 'Sign-in code' and 'Something went wrong'; …

在哪跑：本地 probes（多端探针）；测试方法 MULTI · 多端 / 多账号；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S13 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-25.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane probes。

测试方法：MULTI · 多端 / 多账号；辅助：PW · Playwright 脚本 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：probes。

UAT item: TC-25 Web & Phone Sync · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-25/S13

The computer signs in while the phone is in the middle of a pre-round note

Tickets: TFA-94513 Signing In & Session Security (in progress); TFA-94704 Production Web App Hosting + PWA (development backlog)

本地新 lane probes：probes/results.json 里 status passed → 通过（通过）。

怎么测（probes/plan.json，automatable: yes）：sync-probe both modes: phone types into pre-round; a fresh empty-storage computer opens the chart address (must get the sign-in gate), signs in with its own code, lands on the list; phone still in with its text; phone adds a second line; computer's editor shows both. [Review 2026-10-14] Phone captures are viewport-only (full-page capture resizes a mobile page); editor state read before any capture; caret put at the end and checked; line order asserted in the stored text and the computer's editor. — Second context + runner-issued code; no LLM agent needed.

Detail:

Re-checked after review 2026-10-14 (18:00 JST runs: fix-*.json). Both modes: the fresh computer on the chart address gets 'Send sign-in code' (no name, no text); after its own code it shows the list; the phone (no reload) is still signed in with its text and its fullscreen editor still open (read before any capture, and again after a viewport-only capture); with the caret at the end of the text (checked: at 66/66 Hospital, 43/43 NH) the second line went in after the first: the stored pre-round and the computer's editor hold 'QA-SYNC-PR-4 …' then 'QA-SYNC-PR-5 …' (NH: NPR-4 then NPR-5). The earlier 'editor closed by itself' note and the reversed line order were test artifacts: the full-page screenshot of the mobile page resized it and closed the editor; the reopened editor's caret sat at 0.
